summary: Phase 4 cannot accept this denominator. The raw role receipts do not prove the frozen five-role separation or measured stop-loss compliance, the Phase 4 gate trusts self-authored provenance and owner-approval fields instead of the provider-neutral event resolver, and the claimed human-discovery artifacts contain quarantined failed-track source-list entries and were generated from a hard-coded authored program inventory. No provenance was invented or rewritten during review.
blocking_findings: APK-DEN-B-001: Frozen role separation and receipt provenance are not established.
APK-DEN-B-002: Reviewer and product-owner authorization are self-attested rather than provider-resolved.

APK-DEN-B-006: The Phase 4 raw role log records a nonexistent full commit.

finding_details.title: Frozen role separation and receipt provenance are not established
finding_details.detail: phase0-role-ownership-manifest.json requires five mutually incompatible roles and non-null spawn, ancestry, prompt, context, event, response, output, budget, and commit provenance. Only three receipt files exist. discovery-auditor.json is explicitly retrospective and has four null required fields plus unavailable usage; evidence-collector.json has seven null required fields and null usage; requirements-mapper.json identifies its role as reconciliation-integrator, has seven null required fields and null usage; truth-test-author.json and adversarial-reviewer.json are absent. The frozen rule unmeasured_resource_usage_blocks_checkpoint is true. Phase 4 validates only a future adversarial-reviewer receipt and never validates the complete required role set, so these blockers could be bypassed.
finding_details.remediation: Re-run the affected roles in distinct provider-exportable sessions through the existing provenance adapter, record measured usage, publish canonical receipts for all five frozen roles, and re-run reconciliation. Null limitation text cannot substitute for required provenance.

finding_details.title: Reviewer and product-owner authorization are self-attested rather than provider-resolved
finding_details.detail: The Phase 4 test accepts reviewer isolation from strings inside independent-review.json and accepts product-owner authorization from strings inside product-owner-acceptance.json. It does not call validate_roles_and_outputs or validate_owner_approval, resolve raw provider events, bind actual prompt/context/final-response bytes, enforce event chronology, or consume approval event IDs once. A hand-authored event_id, currently-authorized status, timestamp string, and message digest can satisfy the current checks. The rerun command is also accepted by substring and self-reported status without a committed command transcript or independently generated output comparison.
finding_details.remediation: Route reviewer receipts and owner approval through the accepted provider-neutral EventResolver contracts, verify raw export bytes and event chronology, bind prompt/context/final response and exact write inventory, and consume the owner event once before rendering accepted manifests.

finding_details.title: Failed-track quarantine is present in claimed human and reconciliation source lists
finding_details.detail: The frozen contract excludes factual assertions and source lists below measure/tracks/apk_cross_game_asset_ontology_20260712 except explicit negative failure evidence. independent-human-discovery.json and phase3-reconciliation.json each contain 98 string entries under current_name_matched_paths/current_specification_matched_paths pointing into that failed track, without a quarantine-rejected classification. The Phase 2 generator searches the whole measure root without filtering the quarantine, and the Phase 4 locator validator checks neither allowed roots nor the quarantined prefix.
evidence: programmatic recursive scan: 98 quarantined-path strings in independent-human-discovery.json and 98 in phase3-reconciliation.json
finding_details.remediation: Regenerate the affected human and reconciliation artifacts from the frozen baseline with the failed-track prefix excluded before search results are recorded, or retain any occurrence only in an explicit negative quarantine-rejection collection that cannot influence disposition. Refresh downstream receipts rather than rewriting them.

finding_details.title: The independent human denominator is generated from an authored program inventory
finding_details.detail: generate_phase2_human_discovery.py hard-codes 29 PROGRAM_IDENTITIES transcribed from measure/apk-evidence-reconstruction-program.md, hard-codes a collector identity, and emits records labelled human-raw-source-review. Phase 2 and Phase 3 tests derive the mandatory 29-label partition from the same authored program, while the specification says the denominator must come from raw and historical sources and never future authored requirements. With no authentic evidence-collector session provenance, these generated records do not establish the required independent human path and make mechanical/human agreement circular for the 29-label boundary.
finding_details.remediation: Repeat independent human discovery from frozen raw current and ancestor sources without preloading the authored 29-name list; reconcile the independently found set against authored program names only afterward as a discrepancy input. Preserve a fresh provider-attested collector receipt.

finding_details.title: Candidate, partition, approval, and accepted outputs are not commit-bound and can consume coordinated worktree edits
finding_details.detail: Phase 4 loads Phase 1-3 inputs and all candidate/approval/accepted manifests directly from the working tree. Only independent-review.json is checked against a receipt commit. Candidate and owner artifacts need not exist in any reachable commit, the accepted partition does not bind candidate-partition-manifest.json, and the candidate partition checks only 29 ordered labels rather than exact Phase 3 disposition/source-identity assignments. Coordinated uncommitted edits can therefore satisfy set comparisons and approval hashes without an immutable transition commit.
finding_details.remediation: Require reachable full commit SHAs for every input and transition artifact, read accepted inputs with git show, bind candidate partitions to the exact 29 Phase 3 records including disposition and source identity, and bind accepted partitions to the exact candidate partition bytes.

finding_details.title: The Phase 4 raw role log records a nonexistent full commit
finding_details.detail: phase4-mid-red.log records 71462110f82f740d3609c95e30b559795ab9e525, which git cannot resolve. The actual commit with prefix 71462110 is 71462110f4a74763c284818a9eba45d1ce096ef2. This prevents truthful full-hash binding of the role output. The original log was not rewritten during review.
finding_details.remediation: Publish a separate correction/supersession record bound to the real commit and raw role response; do not silently edit the original role log.

Phase 4 does not validate the complete frozen five-role receipt set or trusted provider events.
